FN-D72XNT-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 85
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Debbie Wood
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/15/2023
House Bill 85as introduced creates an income tax refund check-off beginning in the 2024 tax
year for the State Parks Division of the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources,
Department of Mental Health, and Alabama Medicaid Agency. Based on contributions to the
current voluntary income check-off programs in fiscal year 2022, each agency could receive an
estimated $10,500 annually from the provisions of this bill.
This bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Revenue (DOR) by
a small, undetermined amount, which would be offset by the allowed cost of administration of
up to 5% of collections that may be retained by DOR.
